sections.name: Hook
lines: hg_hook
Over Easter weekend in 2015, a gang of thieves broke into one of London's most secure vaults. The oldest was seventy six.
hg_title
This is the Hatton Garden heist.

sections.name: The vault
lines: hg_garden
Hatton Garden is London's jewellery quarter. Under one of its buildings sits a vault full of safe deposit boxes, packed with gems, gold and cash.
hg_basil
On Thursday night, a mystery man in a ginger wig, known only as Basil, lets the gang into the building.

sections.name: The drill
lines: hg_lift
They climb down the lift shaft to the basement, and set up a huge industrial drill.
hg_wall
Their target is a concrete wall half a metre thick. They drill for hours, and finally break through.
hg_stuck
But behind the wall, a steel cabinet is bolted in place. They can't get past it. The gang goes home empty handed.

sections.name: The return
lines: hg_return
Two nights later, they come back with new equipment. This time, the cabinet crashes to the floor.
hg_boxes
They break open seventy three boxes, and haul away loot worth up to fourteen million pounds.
hg_alarm
The alarm had actually gone off on the first night. But police decided it didn't need a response.

sections.name: The ending
lines: hg_caught
About six weeks later, police raids rounded up the gang. They were jailed in 2016. Basil was finally convicted in 2019.
hg_loot
But most of the loot has never been found.
hg_outro
England's biggest burglary, pulled off by a gang of grandpas. Would you have spotted them? Follow for more true crime, animated.
